requested_order.text: Wegovy (semaglutide) 0.25 mg SC once weekly x4 weeks, then titrate per label to 2.4 mg weekly

weight_management_program.text:
A/P:
1. Obesity, BMI 37.6 — plan starting today:
 - Calorie tracking, ~1800 kcal/day; cut late-night snacking and takeout.
 - Gym sessions (treadmill + light weights) 5 days a week, ~150 min/week.
 - Enrolled in the health system's 12-month lifestyle modification program.
 Follow-up visits planned.
2. GERD — continue omeprazole; avoid late meals.

NUTRITION CONSULT — INITIAL
Date: 12/23/2025
Lifestyle program intake. Food log: takeout after evening shifts, pastries at work, soda.
Plan: calorie tracking at ~1800 kcal/day; pre-shift meal and packed snack; no takeout after shifts; soda to zero-calorie.
Activity: gym 5 days/week (treadmill + weights), ~150 min/week.
RD follow-up 6 weeks.

PRIMARY CARE PROGRESS NOTE
Date: 02/24/2026
S: Follow-up. Continues the calorie tracking and gym plan started in December; good adherence most weeks.
O: Wt 94.7 kg, BMI 37.0. BP 110/67.
A/P:
1. Obesity — continue program.

NUTRITION FOLLOW-UP
Date: 05/20/2026
Food log reviewed: adherent most days; no post-shift takeout; soda switched.
Adjustments: more protein at breakfast; plan for weekend social meals.
Reports keeping up with gym routine.
Continue program.

PRIMARY CARE PROGRESS NOTE
Date: 08/10/2026
S: Follow-up. Continues the diet and exercise plan and program follow-ups since December. Weight 91.9 kg today, down from 96.2 kg (-4.5%). Some improvement, though modest — she feels she has hit a wall and would like more weight loss. Asks about medication. No MTC/MEN2 history, no pancreatitis. Uses IUD.
O: Wt 91.9 kg, BMI 35.9. BP 124/72.
